unmeasurable.text: Claude Code does not record permission prompts, so a long tool run and a wait for approval look the same.
Codex logs nothing while a tool runs and does not record approval waits, so a long command and a wait for approval look the same.
Codex writes no log until the first prompt is sent, so this session cannot be read yet.
Codex does not log hook runs, so failed hooks are not shown for Codex.
